info.title: API.SH: Polymarket
info.description: The Polymarket API from API.SH: public Polymarket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Prediction-market events on Polymarket (an event groups one or more markets): title, description, image, status, volume (total, 24 h, 1 w, 1 m, 1 y), liquidity, open interest, comment count, dates, tags, series and each market with its outcomes and prices. Filter by status, tag, series, featured, volume and liquidity floors and start/end date windows; sort by volume, liquidity, dates or competitiveness. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-events

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: volume_24h (default), volume, liquidity, start_date, end_date, created_at, competitive or comments.

parameters.name: markets
parameters.description: false leaves out each event's markets (smaller answer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-market

parameters.name: holders

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The live order book of one market outcome: every bid and ask level (price 0-1 and size in shares), best bid and ask, spread, midpoint, last trade price, tick size, minimum order size, level counts and total size per side, and the book's timestamp. Pick the market by slug/id/url plus `outcome` (default the first, usually Yes), or pass the outcome's `token_id`. A market that has finished returns an empty book with `closed` true.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-orderbook

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A polymarket.com event or market link.

parameters.name: token_id
parameters.description: The outcome's token id (from `outcomes[].token_id` of /polymarket/v1/market); replaces slug and outcome.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Outcome name, e.g. Yes, No, or a candidate name (default the first outcome).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Return only the best N levels per side (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The price (implied probability, 0-1) of one outcome over time: a point per `fidelity` minutes for a preset `interval`, or between `start` and `end`. Pick the market by slug/id/url plus `outcome` (default the first, usually Yes), or pass the outcome's `token_id`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-price-history

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Outcome name, e.g. Yes or No (default the first outcome).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start (ISO); with `end` instead of `interval`; start to end up to 92 days.

parameters.name: fidelity
parameters.description: Minutes per point (default depends on interval: 1 to 1440).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US Presidential Election?

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-profile

parameters.name: wallet

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The tags Polymarket uses to group events and markets (id, label, slug), or one tag by slug with its related tags. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recent trades of a market, newest first: time, side (BUY or SELL), outcome, price, size in shares, value in USD, wallet and pseudonym of the trader, outcome token id and transaction hash. Pick the market by slug/id/url or `condition_id`. Filter by side, outcome, minimum size (shares) or minimum value (USD), and taker trades only. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Only the latest 10,000 trades of a market are available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/polymarket-trades

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A polymarket.com event or market link.

parameters.name: condition_id
parameters.description: The market's condition id (0x followed by 64 hex characters).

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Only trades of this outcome, e.g. Yes.

parameters.name: min_size
parameters.description: Only trades of at least this many shares.

parameters.name: min_cash
parameters.description: Only trades worth at least this many US dollars (not with min_size).

parameters.name: taker_only
parameters.description: true or false: only taker-side trades.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Only trades of this wallet (0x address).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page (needed past page 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
